author: worker
summary: Migrate the protected test T-CHAIN-001 (contractId TRADE.CHAIN.ORDERED_CAUSAL_SEQUENCE) from the retired Jest file tests/closed-world-chain.test.js to the living probe tools/verification/verify_trade_chain_causal_edges.mjs, and resolve its PENDING_RECONSTRUCTION status: the required order is a relative order of the eight named event types, and the entry additionally binds the parent-linked causal-edge chain of MUT-CHAIN-001.
motivation: Hard Rule 9 retired the Jest suites (2026-09-06); tests/closed-world-chain.test.js no longer exists, so the manifest file/testName references are dead, and the recorded assertions had been weakened from toEqual to toContain (Guardian V3 §1 item #2). The V4 P0 resolution re-derives the authority for the order from the live reducer: runClosedWorldScenario under the sealed preconditions (bandit.lootExpectation === 0.95, bandit.switchMargin === 0) emits the eight required types in a fixed relative order with LAW_VIOLATED interleaving, so exact list equality is the wrong strength while relative order is the correct one. The same probe drives tickClosedWorld over 90 forced-attack ticks and asserts the MUT-CHAIN-001 edge contract (OBSERVATION -> BELIEF_UPDATE -> ROUTE_DECISION -> TRIP_COMMITMENT -> ROUTE_EXPOSURE -> CANDIDATE_ENCOUNTER -> ENCOUNTER -> CONSEQUENCE -> FACTION_REACTION), which the retired tests/causal-chain.test.js could no longer protect.

manifestImpact.currentTestName: connects attack evidence, rumor, rerouting, and faction escalation
manifestImpact.proposedLivingBinding: section 1: runClosedWorldScenario under the sealed preconditions emits CONVOY_FORMED, BANDIT_ATTACK, RUMOR, ROUTE_SELECTED, FACTION_REASSESSMENT, FACTION_ACTION, INVASION, BANDIT_RELOCATION in the required relative order (LAW_VIOLATED interleaves; membership is not sufficient, and exact equality would be wrong). section 2: driven reducer preserves every required causal edge — the route decision names a BELIEF_UPDATE parent whenever the merchant held a belief, TRIP_COMMITMENT names its same-merchant same-tick decision, ROUTE_EXPOSURE names its commitment, CANDIDATE_ENCOUNTER names its exposure, ENCOUNTER names its candidate, BANDIT_ATTACK names its encounter, FACTION_REACTION names its attack, all parent references resolve, and an ancestry walk from the first reaction reaches the root through MERCHANT_ROUTE_DECISION.
manifestImpact.resolution: V4 §7.1 outcome: the contract authority is the relative order of the eight named types (partial order), not exact stream equality; the edge-level requirement is bound from MUT-CHAIN-001's registry statement (legalInformationSource: event causal parents).
manifestImpact.killEvidence: docs/guardian/mutation-receipts/MUT-CHAIN-001-1792297594885.json (KILLED; expected failing probe observed as the sole failure)

registryRebinds.now: tools/verification/verify_trade_chain_causal_edges.mjs > section 2: the route decision must name a BELIEF_UPDATE parent whenever the merchant held a belief (the kill check; under MUT-CHAIN-001 the decision carries parents=[] and the check fails at the first driven tick that follows an observation), and the full parent-linked edge chain holds on the live reducer; section 1: one-shot ordered type sequence under the sealed preconditions
